test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
A # B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If W & Q # T & Y @ M % K, then how is W related to K?
solution:
Given :

A # B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b1d977930a5ae8ff2ad87e3b6407517b08dce70e8f045c243365162391bc53.png] 

W & Q # T & Y @ M % K → W is father of Q, Q is sister of T, T is father of Y, Y is son of M, M is mother of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b174120a8b228dadbdb8263d798b7bf885b77d5adabfe0627bf3d72f04f5a215.png] 

**W is the father's father to K.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3"**
